data_description.bind_host: Use 0.0.0.0 to listen on every network interface.
data_description.respond: Most panels retry forever until they are acknowledged.
data_description.nak_on_bad_crc: Turn this off if a panel gets stuck retransmitting a message it cannot send correctly.
data_description.unknown_account_policy: What to do when a message arrives for an account you have not configured.
data_description.retention_months: Activity older than this is deleted automatically.

account.title: Add an account
account.description: Each account number becomes a device with its own alarm panel, status, heartbeat and activity log.

data_description.account: The hexadecimal account number the panel transmits, 3 to 16 characters.
data_description.encryption_key: Optional AES key as 32, 48 or 64 hexadecimal characters. Leave empty for unencrypted messages. Supplying a key also turns on timestamp replay protection, which you can switch off later by editing the account.
data_description.heartbeat_timeout: The account is marked offline when nothing is received for this long.
data_description.arm_away_target: Optional. DC-09 is receive only, so arming from Home Assistant runs this script, scene or button instead.
data_description.users: Optional. One user per line as number: name, for example 501: Mikkel. Panels report who armed or disarmed as a bare number; naming them here shows "User Mikkel" instead of "User number 501" throughout Home Assistant.
data_description.zones: Optional. One zone or point per line as number: name, for example 10: Office Window Sensor. Naming them here shows "Office Window Sensor" instead of "Zone or point 10" throughout Home Assistant.

error.invalid_host: That is not a valid IP address.
